about: B-ASKJB-44 acceptance: every row the critic used in rounds 1-7 (r1-r3 floor probes, r4 probe, probe5, compare6/7, extra6/7, probe7, esc5, esc6), with main's (5fb5666f) verdict and the required verdict. keep: a real escalation line, a parent-reported finding or hard moment, or no finding. drop: an invented, narrated, hedged or misattributed finding. part:<text>: the note keeps exactly this text (an escalation line loses an invented add-on, or a finding clause after ';'). keep|fn: a parent's reassuring 'no problem' statement the floor may drop (documented false negative). parent '' means the parent wrote nothing that reports it.
